items.t: Google pushed AI into schools, and even students say it's gone too far
items.x: Google researchers warned of cognitive and emotional risks to kids as the company put Gemini on school Chromebooks. Teachers describe falling scores and dependence; districts including New York and Los Angeles have restricted student AI use. Google says its tools help learning and protect under-18s.
